text: Si sirkooɓe ɓen yi'oyii ka laakara reweteeɗi maɓɓe ɗin ɗi ɓe rewaynoo gaain Alla, ɓe wi'a: Joomi amen, ko ɗii woni kafidaaɗi amen ɗi men rewayno gaanin Maa. Ɓe wi'ra ɗum fawugol e majji dolle boneeji maɓɓe ɗin. Kono Alla wowlina ɗin rewetee- ɗi maɓɓe, ɗi ruttira ɓe wiide: Onon ɓee sirkooɓe, ko on fenuɓe e rewugol Mo kafida e Alla ngol. Pellet, O alaa kafidiiɗo mo no rewee.
